title: StateMutex::try_lock_now hides mutex poisoning that lock() reports
outcome: StateMutex::try_lock_now either reports poisoning as lock() does (for example Option<LockResult<StateMutexGuard>>), or its doc says it deliberately ignores poisoning and is for diagnostic use only, so a later caller cannot read state left half-mutated by a panicked holder without knowing it.
acceptance: StateMutex::try_lock_now hides mutex poisoning that lock() reports is done
